notes.title: New DLC Released! Meet... The Night Party!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/REjgHOv.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/723460

[b]The Night Party[/b]
They met at a midnight rave party, and they soon found out they were all outcasts misunderstood by society. Yeah, like teenagers. Only they are much older. Soon they decided to band together and support each other during the long nights. And dance till dawn.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eIho8TH.png[/img]
[list][*]David can’t control his transformation, so when playing him timing is paramount.
[/*][*]When in human form he’s slow and below average for a melee fighter.
[/*][*]But in wolf form he’s fast, deadly and mobile. His leap forward is especially effective.[/*][/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/oYmhHTw.png[/img]
[list][*]Donald is one of the best melee fighters in the game, fast and with good reach.
[/*][*]When struck, he turns into a bat and has the ability to escape and fight another time.[/*][/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/WW22DVi.png[/img]
[list][*]Mr. T’s first form is cumbersome, but can be effective.
[/*][*]However, the sarcophagus is big and an easy target.
[/*][*]When out of his sarcophagus, Mr. T. is a versatile long range fighter with good mobility.[/*][/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/IW66H1g.png[/img]
[list][*]J has a couple of options to use his potions and can play mind games with his opponents.
[/*][*]However, once the potion is gone, J’s options are far more limited.
[/*][*]When transformed, J. is a strong melee fighter who can go berserk.[/*][/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/RTsDjhN.png[/img]
[list][*]Zack can easily surprise the enemy by detaching his head.
[/*][*]While the body is headless, it can’t move, but it’s not defenseless. Plus, it can’t be hurt.
[/*][*]Just focus on avoiding a headshot.[/*][/list]

notes.title: ChangeLog Version 1.02
notes.notes:
This week we have been working on several aspects. Finishing some improvements that we did not have time to include in the last week patch. Some bugs that still remained in the todo list. But mainly most of our work has been getting ready the mac version. It is almost done, the game is working fine in our mac testing machines and once we have completed all the testing we will release it, hopefully along this week.

 
[h1] Gameplay Changes [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]The BlackKnight last form has been improved. Now it has two more attacks. An air drop attack that can be performed with both action buttons while in the air. A forward attack, propelling the character forward.
[/list]

[h1] Bugs Fixed [/h1]
[list]
    [*]There was an issue with the music playing when the game is started even when the music volume was set to 0.
   [*]Fixed an issue the simplified chinese not displaying correctly on the codex.
[/list]

notes.title: ChangeLog Version 1.01
notes.notes:
It has already been a week after the launch and it is time to make some changes from the feedback we have gathered. This are the changes we have made:

[h1] Gameplay Changes [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Increment sacrifice time for People of the Sun. From 1.5 sec to 2.5 sec.
    [*]Huemac superball lasts 5 seconds now. If he does not catch the ball before this time, he will have to wait 5 seconds until he recovers it.
    [*]Allyson got her ammo reduced. From 12 to 6 bullets.
    [*]Gun reloading time has been increased from 0.3 seconds to 0.6 seconds per bullet. This change affects Allyson and Gilly.
    [*]Attracting Teddy bear from Ev4 cost now 1 point of energy instead of being free.
    [*]Lia can pick up the boomerang while doing a roll when it is stucked in the floor.
    [*]Reduced to 1 the number of Air dashes that Cuauhtli while in super.
    [*]Added cooldown between Mike's shieldbash attack.
    [*]Mike in super does not recover the spear after teleporting to it. The explosive teleport has a cooldown of 5 seconds without having the spear.
    [*]All the characters got the invulnerable time after spawning reduced from 2 to 0.5 seconds.
[/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Solved an issue, causing players to join lobbies that have already started a match.
    [*]Solved some errors in the online  synchronization that caused the game to crash or player desyncs.
    [*]Fixed an issue causing the game to crash if it was being executed from the executable, instead of directly from steam.
    [*]Solved a bug when using the keyboard when 4 controllers were plugged in.
[/list]

More changes to come. We will do another update the next week, with more changes that did not got finished for this week update.

notes.title: Plans after release
notes.notes:
Dynasty Feud might be out for you to play, but that doesn’t mean development will stop. There are still some things left that we want to include that were left behind.

Like adding the game modes of All Star and Team Feud to play online on private matches.

We want also to include some game mode ideas that we have and that you the community have proposed.

We will keep on improving the game and giving support whenever is needed. 
This is not the end, it is only the beginning.

If you have any suggestion come to the
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/493180/discussions/] forums[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/r3ZBhsb] Discord[/url] and let us know.

notes.title: Dynasty Feud is finally live
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164139/29595045971ef0333644458dc0d782bae1d82500.png[/img]

The day has come!!!

Dynasty Feud is finally live, go play it now!!!

Enjoy beating your friends and find your true nemesis online. 
It is our first commercial game. The first time we complete the whole process of coming up with the idea, design, prototype and fight against every stone of this awesome journey. 

Dynasty Feud is a game we love (although we hated it from time to time) and this is the moment to share it with everyone. This is not the end of the road for Dynasty Feud, we will keep on improving it and listening to the feedback we get.
 
Thank you for making us happy having a good time with Dynasty Feud!

Have fun!

notes.title: Beta Key revoking confusion
notes.notes:
We realized that the key revoking generated confusion, because it prompted an abrupt message that can lead to misunderstanding. Do not worry about being flagged as "not paying users", we asked Valve about the best way to do it and followed the procedures they suggested, so there is nothing wrong with your account. We understand that the method may not have been the best and we will try to take a different approach next time or at least clarify it earlier.

Sorry again for the inconvenience and thanks for your understanding.

P.D.: The users who won the key during the beta will be contacted before release and they will receive a new key.

notes.title: Last weekend of Beta - Round 5 Now Live!!
notes.notes:
The month of beta has almost gone, and it was quick, really quick. We are really grateful to all of you who played Dynasty Feud, your feedback and support is something really precious to us. It helped us improve the game a lot and there are still a bunch of tasks that we need to do to satisfy your demands, but do not hesitate, we won't forget them.

As the final weekend we will release all the Dynasties that have been tested. There are still two Dynasties that haven't been tested, but there are a few things that we need to do first in order let them loose.

See you in the release!!!

notes.title: Round 3 changelog
notes.notes:
- We have increased the threshold for an inconsistent match, to avoid the sync error. This can lead to matches with more lag but less kicked players.
- We are improving and tweaking the interpolation system to enhance the online experience.
- We have reduced the load of packets sent through the network.
- We have added the previous two dynasties to the game, so that there are 4 dynasties playable with their corresponding level. Clan Yngling, the Cartwrongs, the Fancier's Crew and the Nekoyama-shi.
- We have reduced the number of falling spikes and increased the warning of the crying lava on the Cursed hideout level.
- Jane has been reworked. Now she can shoot in 360 degrees still and can shoot in the air too. We have added a throwable that can stun.
- Allyson now shoots two bullets instead of one.
- Raiga's dash attack now ignores armor.

notes.title: Beta Round 2 changelog
notes.notes:
- Changed how the initial sincronization worked, now it should stabilized better in start of the match, and solved the problem of kicking out people right on the start.
- Fixed an error on the kicking system at the beggining of the matches, kicking withouth collecting enough data.
- Refactor the object poolsa and initialization of the objects in the scenes to improve the time of the loading screens.
- Replaced the ghosting on projectiles with trail to improve performance.
- Interpolate the projectiles and bullets, so the movement will be a lot more smoother.
- Solve several problems with the pause menu in online matches.
- Added an option for the leaderboards in the online menu.
- Added new mastered music songs.
- Bullets collision are now bigger.
- Rosemary, the archeress collision is a little bit taller. Allison's bullets should hit her now.
- Fixed an error that prevented the emotes to work properly.
- Solved some errors when projectiles collides between them.

notes.title: Round 2 already live!
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you for all who participated in the 1st Round, it has ended with great results. Your feedback in the forums and through the email is helping us a lot to polish the final version of Dynasty Feud.

The winner of Round 1 has been clear:
Clan Yngling won 66% and the Cartwrongs 34%, so there seems to be some work for us in balancing them.

We have heard your feedback and improved some of the issues we have. Loading times has been reduced, there is still a lot more room to reduce, so expect more improvements in the coming weeks. We also solved a problem at the start of the matches with the synchronization, so it will happen less and improve the overall stability of the match. And a lot more small changes and fixes. Hopefully, it will improve your experience.

Today starts the Round 2, and as many of you asked for new dynasties we decided to forget the planned schedule and change both. The Round 2 will start with Nekoyama-shi and Fancier´s Crew. From the Caribbean to the land of the Rising Sun, let´s defend your Dynasty!

ROUND 1 WINNERS:
    Angorn
    MontBlanc
    ringo2000
    Roman Reigns
    Etsai
    Rico
    CrimsonRogue
    TDH | PUN1SH3R
    yosu33
    BarkingOnion

THANK YOU!
KEEP UP THE GOOD FIGHT!
